title: Petition of Intervention for Association of Louisiana Electric Cooperatives, Inc. (ALEC)

documents.text:
BEFORE THE


                            LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION


                                          DOCKET NO. U—37882


     ENTERGY LOUISIANA, LLC,
     EX PARTE



     Application for certification of generation and transmission resources and for other relief.


                                      PETITION OF INTERVENTION


              NOW    BEFORE the        Louisiana Public       Service    Commission     (the “Commission”   or




     “LPSC”), through undersigned counsel, comes the Association of Louisiana Electric Cooperatives,

     Inc.   (“ALEC”) and its member cooperatives, Beauregard Electric Cooperative, Inc. (“BECi”),

     Claiborne Electric    Cooperative,   Inc.   (“Claiborne”), Dixie      Electric   Membership Corporation

     (“DEMCO”), Jefferson Davis Electric Cooperative,             Inc.   (“JDEC”), Panola-Harrison Electric

     Cooperative, Inc. (“PHEC”), South Louisiana Electric Cooperative Association (“SLECA”), and

     Washington-St. Tammany Electric Cooperative, Inc. (“WST”), who hereby ﬁle this Petition of

     Intervention in the above captioned docket, asserting as follows:


                                                         1.


              ALEC is a cooperative association and trade organization which exists to represent the


     mutual interests of regulated electric cooperatives providing service in Louisiana.            One of the


     functions of ALEC is to represent its electric cooperative members in connection with matters of


     mutual interest and importance, including regulatory matters before the LPSC.           ALEC maintains


     its principal place of business at 10725 Airline Highway, Baton Rouge, Louisiana 70816.


                                                        2.


              The ALEC member        cooperatives are each rural electric cooperatives, which provide




RM
 electric service to over 300,000 meters statewide in 38 of the state’s 64 parishes. The rates and


services of each ALEC     cooperative are regulated by the Commission.     The principal place of


business of each ALEC cooperative is on record with and maintained by the Commission.


                                                3.


       The Commission issued a published notice of this proceeding the above-captioned docket


in the Commission’s Official Bulletin No. 1372, on March 27, 2026.       The proceeding has been


described as a docket for Entergy Louisiana, LLC (“ELL”)’s application for approval of generation


and transmission resources and for other relief in connection with service to a large hyperscale


data center to be developed by Evest LLC in Richland Parish, Louisiana adjacent to the facility


currently being developed by Laidley, LLC in Richland Parish, Louisiana, that was the subject of

ELL’s Application in LPSC Docket No. U-37425.         In this Application, ELL is seeking, amongst


other things, the approval of generation and transmission resources as further described in the


application.

                                                4.


       As LPSC-regulated electric utilities, the ALEC member cooperatives each have an interest


this proceeding. In addition, as a trade organization representing the ALEC cooperatives’ mutual


interests, ALEC has an interest in this proceeding.

                                                5.


       The deadline for ﬁling interventions in this matter is set at ﬁfteen (15) days from the date


of the LPSC’s Ofﬁcial Bulletin No. 1372, or by April 13, 2026, as computed in accordance with


the LPSC’s Rules of Practice and Procedure. Therefore, this intervention by ALEC and its member


cooperatives is timely.
                                                   6.


       All communications and pleadings in this docket should be directed to:

Service List for this proceeding.


        WHEREFORE, the Association of Louisiana Electric Cooperatives, Inc. and its member


cooperatives, Beauregard Electric Cooperative, Inc., Claiborne Electric Cooperative, Inc., Dixie

Electric   Membership Corporation, Jefferson Davis Electric Cooperative, Inc., Panola—Harrison

Electric Cooperative, Inc., South Louisiana Electric Cooperative Association, and Washington-St.


Tammany Electric Cooperative, Inc., hereby ﬁle this Petition of Intervention in the above-

captioned docket and respectfully request that they be allowed to intervene in this proceeding and

be placed on the LPSC official service list for this docket and included in the active participant list


of parties in this docket.
